doc.brief: The QSizePolicy class is a layout attribute describing horizontal and vertical resizing policy.
doc.index_brief: Layout attribute describing horizontal and vertical resizing policy

QDataStream & operator<<(QDataStream &st.brief: Writes the size *policy* to the data stream *stream*.

QDataStream & operator>>(QDataStream &st.brief: Reads the size *policy* from the data stream *stream*.

QSizePolicy transposed() const.brief: Returns a size policy object with the horizontal and vertical policies and stretches swapped.

QSizePolicy().brief: Constructs a QSizePolicy object with [Fixed](xref:qt:QSizePolicy) as its horizontal and vertical policies.

QSizePolicy(QSizePolicy::Policy horizont.brief: Constructs a QSizePolicy object with the given *horizontal* and *vertical* policies, and the specified control *type*.

QSizePolicy::ControlType controlType() c.brief: Returns the control type associated with the widget for which this size policy applies.

QSizePolicy::Policy horizontalPolicy() c.brief: Returns the horizontal component of the size policy.

QSizePolicy::Policy verticalPolicy() con.brief: Returns the vertical component of the size policy.

Qt::Orientations expandingDirections() c.brief: Returns whether a widget can make use of more space than the [QWidget::sizeHint](xref:qt:QWidget)() function indicates.

bool hasHeightForWidth() const.brief: Returns `true` if the widget's preferred height depends on its width; otherwise returns `false`.

bool hasWidthForHeight() const.brief: Returns `true` if the widget's width depends on its height; otherwise returns `false`.

bool operator!=(const QSizePolicy &other.brief: Returns `true` if this policy is different from *other*; otherwise returns `false`.

bool operator==(const QSizePolicy &other.brief: Returns `true` if this policy is equal to *other*; otherwise returns `false`.

bool retainSizeWhenHidden() const.brief: Returns whether the layout should retain the widget's size when it is hidden.

int horizontalStretch() const.brief: Returns the horizontal stretch factor of the size policy.

size_t qHash(QSizePolicy key, size_t see.brief: Returns the hash value for *key*, using *seed* to seed the calculation.

void setHeightForWidth(bool dependent).brief: Sets the flag determining whether the widget's preferred height depends on its width, to *dependent*.

void setHorizontalPolicy(QSizePolicy::Po.brief: Sets the horizontal component to the given *policy*.

void setRetainSizeWhenHidden(bool retain.brief: Sets whether a layout should retain the widget's size when it is hidden.

void setVerticalPolicy(QSizePolicy::Poli.brief: Sets the vertical component to the given *policy*.
